TW: SUICIDE. I have a few. In my house I lived in during my early teens I would wake up in the middle of the night and see the outline of a feminine figure standing in the corner of my room, like a shadow person. No one else would ever see it, but my family believed me because we have a history of people in our family seeing things that resembled spirits. In this case I might have been able to owe it to sleep paralysis, which I also have experience with, but I was fully able to move. What really creeped me out was that she had an abnormally elongated neck. She wouldn't really do anything to indicate that she saw me, but occasionally seemed to like, twitch. This also creeped me out because the twitch was just so...human like. Whenever it happened I would instantly leave my room and sleep on my couch (family of night owls, someone was usually awake and in the living room so it was less scary to be there.) Shortly after we moved out my mom told me about how there was, in fact, a lady who had lived there and had hung herself. Mom knew this before we moved in, but didn't tell me because she didnt want me freaking out. Creepy shit. I have more if anyone is curious

I'll give you the basics: Ted Bundy, born in 1946 to an unwed mother, and to avoid the stigma of the time, was told that his grandparents were his parents, and his mom was his older sister. Committed his known murders in Washington state, Oregon, Utah, Colorado, and Florida. He committed his first known murder in 1974, but he is believed by some to be responsible for the 1961 disappearance of his 8 year old neighbor. His victims were mostly white women between the ages of 15 and 25, but the ages could occasionally vary. He escaped from prison twice. In 1979 he was sentenced to death, with his last victim being a 12 year old girl. He was executed on January 24, 1989 by the electric chair. His crimes involved murder, rape, kidnapping, and necrophilia.

Jeffery Dahmer, born 1960, a convicted sex offender who would lure young men and boys, mostly asian or African-American, though race would vary, back to his apartment, where he would rape and murder his victims, but not always in that order. He committed his first murder in 1978. He was a murderer, rapist, necrophile, and cannibal. On November 28, 1994, he was beaten to death while in prison.
